SECTION C: STATEMENT OF WORK (SOW) - HIGH STRENGTH HY-80 STEEL PRESSURE HULL FABRICATION

1. SCOPE: This specification establishes the minimum metallurgical, ultrasonic, and radiographic testing requirements for structural submarine hull penetration collars installed on Virginia-class submarines.

2. APPLICABLE MILITARY SPECIFICATIONS: MIL-S-16216 (Steel Plate, Alloy, Structural, High Yield Strength HY-80 and HY-100): NAVSEA Technical Publication T9074-AD-GIB-010/1688 (Requirements for Fabrication, Welding and Inspection of Submarine Structure); MIL-STD-2035 (Ultrasonic Inspection Acceptance Criteria).

3. QUALITY ASSURANCE PROVISIONS: Contractor shall maintain an ISO 9001 / AS9100 certified quality management system. 100% of all full-penetration butt welds shall undergo magnetic particle testing (MT) per ASTM E1444 and volumetric radiographical testing (RT) per ASTM E1742 Level 2-1T sensitivity.

4. TRACEABILITY & MATERIAL TEST REPORTS: Certified Material Test Reports (CMTR) documenting chemical melt analysis (C, Mn, P, S, Si, Ni, Cr, Mo, V) and Charpy V-Notch impact energy (minimum 60 ft-lbs at -120 deg F) shall accompany each delivery lot.

ARTICLE 14 (EXTRADITION AND MUTUAL LEGAL ASSISTANCE / ESTRADIZIONE ED ASSISTENZA GIUDIZIARIA):

EN: Each Contracting State undertakes to surrender to the other, in accordance with the provisions of this Treaty, any person who is found in its territory and is requested by the competent judicial authorities for prosecution, extraditable offense carrying a maximum penalty of deprivation of liberty exceeding one year.

IT: Ciascuno Stato contraente si obbliga ad estradare verso l'altro, in conformità alle norme del presente Trattato, le persone che si trovino sul suo territorio e siano perseguite dalle competenti autorita giudiziarie per reati puniti restritiva della libertà personale superiore ad un anno.

ARTICLE 15 (DOUBLE JEOPARDY AND NE BIS IN IDEM / DIVIETO DI DOPPIO GIUDIZIO):

EN: Extradition shall not be granted if the person sought has been tried and convicted or acquitted in the Requested State for the identical acts and offenses upon which the request for extradition is founded.

IT: L'estradizione non sara concessa qualora la persona richiesta sia gia stata giudicata con sentenza definitiva di condanna o proscioglimento nello Stato richiesto per i medesimi fatti reato.

ARTICLE 16 (TRANSLATION AND AUTHENTICATION / TRADUZIONE ED AUTENTICAZIONE):

EN/IT: All formal rogatory requests, affidavits, court warrants, and evidentiary exhibits shall be accompanied by an official certified translation into the language of the Requested State.
